The real viewer creates a fresh RenderSession and VulkanDevice for every refinement sample and camera restart; the former device-local pipeline map disappeared with each frame, and compute-pipeline creation received no VkPipelineCache. Reusing the entire device without changing ownership would accumulate kernel modules and governed buffers, so this repair preserves per-device resources and shares only one bounded process-lived serialized pipeline-cache blob.

The blob is at most 32 MiB, exported whole, and imported only with the exact version-one little-endian header, vendor, device and pipeline UUID. Only actual driver-exported bytes reach the driver; incompatible/truncated/oversized/incomplete exports decline as optimization data. The cache is internally synchronized by Vulkan and the one host slot is mutex-protected. Cache allocation/import/export failure preserves usable uncached execution. Driver-internal cache memory is reported separately from explicit governed buffers. No shader/program words, numerical controllers, stage graph, original samples, scientific checks or buffers were changed. Vulkan's intended reuse contract: https://docs.vulkan.org/refpages/latest/refpages/source/vkGetPipelineCacheData.html.
